author: dutchgamer1607
body:
Dear staff of Apeal an Infraction.

3 years ago I played on avicus and I got banned for flying/hacking on May 23th, 2015.
The ban was properly.
I am sorry and I regret.
I want to start over again and play fair.
I am sorry to all the guys that I have slain using my hacks ):
It was not my meaning to ruin a game in Nebula with my hacks.
I hope there is a possibility, that I could be unbanned.
Once again sorry.
I respect the decision you take and of course I hope I get unbanned, but that's not up to me.
Thanks for the attention

With kine regards dutchgamer1607
